description: This file defines a PHP class 'ProjectViewResourceList' extending 'SugarView'. It handles displaying a resource list view for a project management module, including injecting stylesheets, scripts, and HTML markup for a Gantt chart view within the SuiteCRM framework.

classes.name: ProjectViewResourceList
classes.description: A view class for rendering the resource list in the project module with Gantt chart visualization.

methods.name: display
methods.description: Outputs HTML, CSS, and JavaScript to render the resource list Gantt chart view.
